metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · Vishwanath and Sons
metas.description: Sanjay Vishwanath has devoted decades to excellence as an international shooter. When age, family duties, and an unexpected romance collide with his ambitions, he must confront what truly makes a life worth living.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2026 · Youth
metas.description: 15-year-old Praveen enters adolescence determined to find true love before school ends. Through relationships and heartbreaks, he discovers love's real meaning, shaping his maturity and outlook on life.

metas.name: ★ 9.1 · 2026 · Baththa
metas.description: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally locks a feared criminal inside a school restroom. As the man faces hunger and isolation, an unexpected friendship forms between them, transforming both their lives.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · Nooru Saami
metas.description: Selvi, a widowed mother, devotes her life to raising her two sons in a conservative village. Years later, unfulfilled life comes back into focus, challenging deep-rooted traditions. As family and society strongly oppose change, Selvi must choose between societal expectations and her own happiness.
